description.zh: 是否释放Node所在ens实例，默认为true
description.en: Specifies whether to release the underlying ENS instance for the node. Default value: `true`.

descriptions.zh: 若ReleaseNode为false，在调用DeleteClusterNodes前必需先手动停止node上的kubelet进程，不然node可能会重新自动加入到集群中
descriptions.en: If you set the `ReleaseNode` parameter to `false`, you must manually stop the kubelet process on the node before calling this operation. Otherwise, the node may automatically rejoin the cluster.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens delete-cluster-nodes --cluster-id eck-xxxxxxxx --biz-body '{"Nodes":["i-5xxxxxxxxxxx"]}' --release-node true --region cn-hangzhou
